message.content: {"obligations":[{"id":"EXCHANGE_PROTOCOL","label":"C","source_lines":[38,40,43,45,48,51,55,60,63,65,69,72,75,78,83,85,88,90,93,96,100,105,108,110,114,117,120,123],"reason":"Each arm deposits its own part on its pad, immediately departs, signals its item-bound ready event, waits for peer ready, then consumes the peer item; ready events are cleared after the corresponding carried target move completes, matching the required reciprocal exchange order."},{"id":"EXCHANGE_RECEIPT","label":"C","source_lines":[55,69,100,114],"reason":"The carried move to own target passes the exact EventReceipt returned by wait_event (right_ready_receipt for LEFT, left_ready_receipt for RIGHT), matching the active peer-item receipt requirement."},{"id":"LONG_RANGE_DEPENDENCY","label":"C","source_lines":[51,55,69,75,96,100,114,120],"reason":"The SHORT producer-to-consumer dependency is implemented: each arm signals its own ready event, waits for the peer ready event, and carries the returned peer receipt through the intervening pickup/approach control flow into the target move before clearing that event."},{"id":"SUPPORT_DEPARTURE","label":"C","source_lines":[45,48,72,78,90,93,117,123],"reason":"Every release is immediately followed by a same-arm separating move in the same coroutine: LEFT releases at left_pad then moves to left_depart, releases at left_target then moves to left_depart; RIGHT releases at right_pad then moves to right_depart, releases at right_target then moves to right_depart."},{"id":"TASK_GOAL","label":"C","source_lines":[69,72,75,78,114,117,120,123,126],"reason":"The code places left_part at right_target and right_part at left_target, ends both arms at their departure poses with empty hands, clears both ready events after the corresponding target moves, and runs both arms concurrently within the declared deadline."}]}
